install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-b91275eb3c9bdcd3df3a，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-any-attachment 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b91275eb3c9bdcd3df3a.html
posts.en:
dsh-any-attachment is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b91275eb3c9bdcd3df3a.html
